readiness_words: A data store this workload reaches changes protocol or has no assessed protocol, and its code migration decision is not answered: StackToIT keeps the workload blocked until the customer answers it in the decisions file. StackToIT keeps the workload blocked: the database engine version 3.3 is not offered in the region; the application cannot be verified against a downgraded engine until the decision DEC-GEN-CONVERT-ENGINE-VERSION-DOWNGRADE is answered (the customer answers it in the decisions file).
validation_scope: A kubeconform check or a kubectl apply --dry-run of the manifest establishes YAML validity only, not behaviour: it accepts a REQUIRED_ token in a string field, an empty ConfigMap and a Secret that does not exist, and runs nothing; the checklist of the application compatibility contract and an application smoke test on the target are what show that the workload works.

endpoints.source: catalog:80 (the Service Connect alias of port catalog-service in the namespace retailstore.local)
endpoints.target: catalog:80 (the Kubernetes Service catalog, port 80 → container port 8080, in the namespace the manifests are applied into)
endpoints.work: the Kubernetes Service keeps the name and port the clients call: check that they resolve it from their namespace; the Service Connect proxy (its retries, timeouts, TLS and metrics) is not carried

identity.target: open: the decision target.workload.identity (inputs.json) chooses federated_service_account (a Kubernetes ServiceAccount federated to the STACKIT service account of the role), service_account_key (a key of that service account mounted as a Secret) or no_workload_identity
identity.work: answer target.workload.identity for module.retail_app_ecs.module.catalog_service.aws_ecs_service.this; until then the pods run with no identity and every call the application made with the task role module.retail_app_ecs.module.catalog_service.aws_iam_role.task_role fails
manual_steps: answer the input target.workload.identity for module.retail_app_ecs.module.catalog_service.aws_ecs_service.this in inputs.json: with federated_service_account the draft writes the stackit_service_account of module.retail_app_ecs.module.catalog_service.aws_iam_role.task_role, its federated identity provider for the SKE cluster's service-account issuer and the Kubernetes ServiceAccount catalog in the manifest

until then, create a STACKIT service account named after the task role module.retail_app_ecs.module.catalog_service.aws_iam_role.task_role and grant it the role assignments the policies of module.retail_app_ecs.module.catalog_service.aws_iam_role.task_role give (identity.tf lists them as the architect's variable)

federate it to the SKE cluster's service-account issuer for the subject system:serviceaccount:<namespace>:catalog, and apply the ServiceAccount of applications/catalog.templates.yaml (its annotation holds the service account's e-mail) in the namespace of the workload

change the application from the AWS SDK credential chain to the STACKIT SDK, which picks up the projected token: every call the application made with module.retail_app_ecs.module.catalog_service.aws_iam_role.task_role fails until it does

code_migration.question: The protocol compatibility of OpenSearch and the target stackit_opensearch_instance.dependencies_catalog_opensearch_this is not assessed: has the application's use of it been checked?

options.title: the calls the application makes were checked against the target store and found compatible
a target store that speaks the protocol of the source is wanted instead: the draft is regenerated with it, and the workload stays blocked until then

engine_downgrade.words: the database engine version 3.3 is not offered in the region; the application cannot be verified against a downgraded engine until the decision DEC-GEN-CONVERT-ENGINE-VERSION-DOWNGRADE is answered

datastores.evidence: module.retail_app_ecs.module.catalog_service.aws_ecs_task_definition.this reads the secret module.retail_app_ecs.aws_secretsmanager_secret_version.catalog_db, which is built from module.dependencies.module.catalog_rds.aws_rds_cluster.this
datastores.work: the target stackit_mariadb_instance.dependencies_catalog_rds_this (MariaDB) speaks the MySQL wire protocol, so a setting that selects the MySQL driver stays; MariaDB 10.11 documents incompatibilities with MySQL 8.0 that the application can meet (the authentication plugin of its accounts, the JSON type and operators, the default collation and sql_mode: the findings of the data store), and which of them it uses is not assessed: run the schema and the queries of the application against a MariaDB instance before the manifest is applied

dns_dependencies.target: the host name the STACKIT instance stackit_opensearch_instance.dependencies_catalog_opensearch_this (OpenSearch) publishes, read from the instance and its credential after it is applied; the draft holds no value of it
